'''''The Empire Wants You!''''' was one of a series of [[Propaganda/Legends|recruitment]] videos issued by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] encouraging that various people in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] join the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. It also unveiled four individuals wanted for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].

The video mentioned that the Empire wanted the viewer to join, and promised that there would be "great benefits" to joining immediately. During the ad, several rows of stormtroopers, alongside red flags bearing the symbol of the Galactic Empire swaying behind them, were facing the screen. It then showed four individuals wanted by the Galactic Empire for treason, including [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

The video included writing in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]], and a third writing system.

==Behind the scenes==
''The Empire Wants You!'' and ''[[Be a Stormtrooper!]]'' were videos shown in the queue area of the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''. The inclusion of Luke Skywalker in the list of wanted criminals seems to conflict with the attraction's setting of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].
